note: Issue 397, contacts.md sections 6 and 7 and the Author's ruling on the ticket: a contact remembers what HE did for the PC, and asks something back on the strength of it. This governor reaches for the most valuable thing he did - goods his town shipped on the PC's order, as it weighs now, halving every 24 months - and asks for a quarter of that in gold for his town's purse (#400's path). Both figures are true: the amount and resource are what actually left his town. Skippable: a man choosing to ask. Placeholder prose.

body.text: You will recall that {param:months_ago} months ago this town sent the Crown {param:sent_amount} of {param:sent_resource}, when you asked it of us.
We did not ask what it cost us, and I will not tell you now. I will only say that {param:town} has not had an easy year since, and that {param:ask} would go a long way here.
I ask it as one who has done his part, and I hope that is how it is read.
I would not have to remind you if the Crown remembered its friends as well as it remembers its debtors.

options.text: and have not forgotten what your town did
and have looked into the matter
and note you have kept a careful account
and wish I had better to send than words

options.label: send the town {param:ask}
options.text: The Crown will send {param:ask} to {param:town}. It is owed, and I would rather pay it than be reminded twice.

options.label: tell him there is nothing to send
options.text: There is nothing to send. I remember what your town did, and I am sorry that remembering is all I can do for it.

tone.hateful: Kindly keep your accounts to yourself in future.
